system.description: A coolant system for customized combustion engines (not motorcycles): one level per level of engine customization, at most +2. While it runs, Signature +1 and Speed −15 m/turn a level, for 60 − 5 × level minutes; then Signature 2 for 10 minutes. Parts: the engine customization's cost × 2, +0.25 for each further level. R3R p.134.
